question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**developed**" means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate. (विकसित)
 
• The phrase** "how it has grown and developed" **is logical and suggests a process of growth and further advancement over time.
 
• The other options: "**solved**," "**juggled**," and "**erupted**" do not fit the context or convey the intended meaning.

**Complete Sentence:** Psychology is an exciting field and the history of psychology offers the opportunity to make sense of how it has grown and **developed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solved (हल किया)**: means finding an answer to a problem, not suitable in context.
 
• **Juggled (जुगलिंग करना)**: means continuously toss in the air and catch (a number of objects), not fitting in this context.
 
• **Erupted (फूटना)**: means to explode, also not suitable for the context.
